facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs runs the smart ID card programme and, with banking partners, issues smart IDs through 372 participating bank branches.

ZAF.note: No register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Smart ID cards, first introduced in 2013, are issued by Home Affairs including through 372 bank branches, with over half a million switches from the green ID book.
